ideas.pitch: An offline-first AR and geospatial routing mobile web app tailored specifically for the PCE campus in Digdoh to help visitors navigate classrooms and labs during the Grand Innovation Challenge.
ideas.title: Digdoh Campus Navigator
ideas.why_it_could_win: It targets the local context of PCE in Digdoh, giving judges a utility tool they can immediately test on-site.

ideas.pitch: A real-time sentiment analysis dashboard that aggregates and processes social posts and feedback from participants during the Grand Innovation Challenge.
ideas.title: PCE Event Pulse
ideas.why_it_could_win: Organizers and judges at PCE will appreciate a meta-tool that measures the success and live mood of their own hackathon event.

ideas.pitch: A localized nutrition and budget optimization web app designed for PCE hostel students to plan healthy meals based on local mess ingredients and market pricing.
ideas.title: Mess Menu Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: It solves an everyday, highly relatable problem for students living around Digdoh, ensuring high emotional resonance with judges.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight proximity-based check-in system utilizing secure local network tokens to streamline attendance tracking for hackathons and college workshops at PCE.
ideas.title: PCE Attendance Verification
ideas.why_it_could_win: It addresses a recurring logistical headache for the organizing department at PCE, making it practically useful post-hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local digital storefront aggregator connecting small food vendors and stationery shops around Digdoh with PCE students.
ideas.title: Digdoh Local Vendor Directory
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges value community-focused projects that demonstrate economic impact right outside the college gates in Digdoh.
